Primary_Outcome: P-selectin/PAC-1, platelet-leukocyte aggregates, GPVI/PF4 binding, megakaryocyte endpoints
Evidence_Base: 75 curated human ex vivo rows plus 81 qualified Sewing reconstruction rows
Permitted_Data: Exact-sequence human mechanistic records with endpoint-specific controls
Excluded_Data: Clinical platelet-count labels and animal outcomes
Required_Validation: Group by exact sequence, scaffold, study, donor/experiment; report publication-aware validation
Remaining_Blocker: Raw Sewing S1 would improve quantitative resolution
Allowed_Claim: Sequence/chemistry features show mechanistic signal under defined human assay conditions.
Prohibited_Claim: Do not claim prediction of clinical thrombocytopenia.

Primary_Outcome: Clinical platelet outcomes under same nucleotide sequence but different construct/regimen
Permitted_Data: Matched pair and clinical context sheets
Required_Validation: Keep pair members together; preserve cross-trial/historical/switch limitations
Remaining_Blocker: No randomized factorial comparison isolating GalNAc or dose
Allowed_Claim: Clinical platelet risk cannot be represented by nucleotide sequence alone.
Prohibited_Claim: Do not claim GalNAc alone prevents thrombocytopenia.

Primary_Outcome: Absolute count, percent decline, nadir, severity, recovery, dose, interval, route, conjugate, population
Evidence_Base: 35 human clinical records plus pooled context and matched pairs
Permitted_Data: Scientist-approved clinical records with full treatment context
Excluded_Data: Unknowns, unmonitored compounds, abstract-only rates without denominators
Required_Validation: Group by compound/program and preserve endpoint-specific labels; use calibration and uncertainty
Remaining_Blocker: Too few clean, fully labeled per-sequence comparators; missing patient-level context
Allowed_Claim: A treatment-aware risk architecture is scientifically justified.
Prohibited_Claim: Do not claim a validated clinical risk predictor yet.

Primary_Outcome: Overall clinical toxicity label from sequence/chemistry alone
Evidence_Base: Four positive anchors; zero clean sequence-linked clinical negatives
Excluded_Data: Matched-context comparators, pooled placebo, absence of reporting, endpoint-specific negatives
Required_Validation: Would require sequence-family split, publication grouping, untouched holdout, calibration and uncertainty
Remaining_Blocker: No defensible negative class; same-sequence pairs show context dependence
Allowed_Claim: The current evidence demonstrates why this abstraction is incomplete.
Prohibited_Claim: Do not balance the dataset by manufacturing negatives.
Owner_Next: German blocks release; Gustavo no training

Primary_Outcome: Incidence and mean platelet change by dose and threshold
Evidence_Base: Crooke main paper and official aggregate supplement
Permitted_Data: Pooled dose bands and placebo-controlled summaries
Excluded_Data: Per-sequence labels inferred from pooled bands
Required_Validation: Report exact denominator for each panel and confidence intervals where available
Remaining_Blocker: Aggregate design cannot identify individual sequence risk
Allowed_Claim: Pooled exposure is associated with moderate platelet declines at higher dose bands.
Prohibited_Claim: Do not infer which unnamed sequence is safe or toxic.

Primary_Outcome: Profound nadir, antibody evidence, hemorrhage, recovery/management
Evidence_Base: Inotersen severe cases and volanesorsen severe events
Required_Validation: Preserve individual case features and avoid double-counting lab/SAE/bleeding outcomes
Remaining_Blocker: Event count is too small for robust supervised modeling
Allowed_Claim: Severe events may represent a biologically distinct phenotype.
Prohibited_Claim: Do not merge phenotype 2 with moderate phenotype 1.

Primary_Outcome: aPTT, PT/INR, factor inhibition, bleeding and thrombosis
Evidence_Base: Human clinical and plasma evidence in separate tables
Required_Validation: Separate intended pharmacology from adverse coagulation effects
Remaining_Blocker: Some primary sequence/chemistry supplements remain missing
Allowed_Claim: Coagulation and platelet-count toxicities are related but distinct.
Prohibited_Claim: Do not merge aPTT prolongation with thrombocytopenia.

Evidence_Base: Human intended pharmacology and therapeutic correction records
Allowed_Claim: The dataset can distinguish benefit, pharmacology, and toxicity.
Prohibited_Claim: Do not call therapeutic correction a negative toxicity outcome.
